title: Bridge Round 9 Stills
heading: Bridge round 12 stills: Maddie on the open grass, the aerial coming out
intro: Round 5, from your timeline round 12 notes (at1559, at1838, at1892): we've left the bunker; Maddie rolls along a plain field, the camera in front of her as in the kill-bot street shot, and the aerial comes out the same way as in scene A. Pick one; no video until you do. Earlier rounds folded below.

sections.lede: No bunker, no wreck, no town: open grass, grey overcast.

groups.title: Maddie in the field (she calls the boss here)
groups.line: The clip will track in front of her as she rolls, like scene A's street run, then her hatch opens and the aerial rises like scene A's call shot. Two references are shown first.

sections.lede: Kai: 'an extra way much wider shot before we switch to the next day'; the wreck on Maddie's right; her aerial comes out outside the bunker.

sections.lede: New Omni 1.2 clips from the plates already approved (LADY0, LADY6, Derek at the periscope), with Kai's picked voices placed on the mouths. Omni read three of the four lines about 1.4x faster than the voices, so two of them only roughly fit. The fix that doesn't re-voice anything is LatentSync, which redraws the mouth to the voice on our own GPU: the inputs are ready, and it needs one command from you.

groups.title: Old lady: "You mean... killing everybody."
groups.line: FITS. Both phrases land on her mouth: 'You mean' at x1.00, 'killing everybody' slowed to x0.85 to fill her mouth. Her mouth moves only a little; it is a quiet read.

opts.label: new clip, muted, with the picked voice fitted (sound on)

groups.title: Old lady: "Are you literally joking?"
groups.line: Rough fit. She shouts it in 1.5 s; the voice takes 2.3 s. Sped up to x1.2, it still runs 0.3 s after her mouth closes, and at that speed 'joking' starts to blur. Best fixed by redrawing the mouth (see below).

opts.label: new clip, muted, with the picked voice fitted (sound on)
opts.warn: Voice runs past the mouth; 'joking' blurs at x1.2

groups.title: Old lady: "Derek, go and have a look what that was."
groups.line: Close. She turns away first, then turns back and talks: 'Derek' at x1.30, the rest at x1.00 on her mouth (1.55 to 3.1 s). The horn stays hanging behind her.

opts.label: new clip, muted, with the picked voice fitted (sound on)

groups.title: Derek: "They've blown up their own kill bot!"
groups.line: Rough fit. He pulls off the periscope wide-eyed and says it half-laughing, but in 1.6 s; the voice takes 2.3 s. At x1.2 it runs 0.3 s past his mouth. He turns to camera right, not towards Sandra. Best fixed by redrawing the mouth.

opts.label: new clip, muted, with the picked voice fitted (sound on)
opts.warn: Voice runs past the mouth; turns away from Sandra
